{{Dialogue|Solo|Who are these people?|Brand|A whole civilization cut off from the rest of the galaxy by that cloud. They cannot get out! And very few people ever get in&hellip; Left to their own resources, they have developed this technology. It's bizarre&hellip; but functional.|Organa Solo|And you?|Brand|They say a Jedi can rule those less powerful than himself. This, I have done here&hellip; I hope with justice!|attr=[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Empatojayos Brand]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|src=<ref name="DEIIa">[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Ganathan Empire''' was the planetary government of the [[Ganathan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. During [[Operation Shadow Hand]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was ruled by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Empatojayos Brand]].
